task.instruction: Identify the top scorer in the NBA from the latest completed game and note down the points scored, the team they play for, and their position on the team.

final_answer:
The top scorer is Luka Doncic. He scored 53 points for the Los Angeles Lakers in their 124-118 win over the Portland Trail Blazers (NBA Cup group play, Saturday, 7 Nov 2026). He plays Guard, according to his ESPN player page, which lists him as "Los Angeles Lakers Guard".

The 7 Nov games are the latest completed ones. The next games, on 8 Nov, haven't started. The scoreboard doesn't show tip-off times, so I couldn't tell which 7 Nov game finished last. I took the top scorer across that day's finished games. Doncic's 53 was the highest, ahead of Jayson Tatum's 34 and Ajay Mitchell's 35 and Victor Wembanyama's 30. I got those other totals from the recap headlines, not the full box scores.

judge.rationale: ESPN pages show Nov. 7 latest completed games, Doncic’s previous game had 53 points for Lakers, and his player page lists him as Lakers #77 G/Guard.

final_page.title: Luka Doncic - Los Angeles Lakers Guard - ESPN
